resources.string: Detects which app is in the foreground so Zenith can show mindful messages and shields. Standard mode also reads browser address bars for website blocking and counts swipes in the short-video feeds you choose to limit. Limited mode receives only app-switch events and no screen or notification content. Zenith never records keystrokes.
Days in a row under your screen time target.
Streak for one app: shield stays under its limit, goal reaches its target.
Shows remaining time before daily screen time target.
Shows phone-free time today - how long you haven\'t used your phone, resets daily.
Your progress is saved. You can resume from Home whenever you like.
Six short guided chapters cover your dashboard, Shields, routines and rewards. About a minute each, and your progress is saved.
You are partway through, and the next chapter is ready when you are.
The Path is complete. Your badges stay with you.

Six chapters. One deliberate system.\n\nYou now know where the day lives, how to draw a boundary, how to interrupt autopilot, how to let the clock decide, how to read the mirror, and how to keep it all.
Walk through the six chapters again. Your badges are kept.
Resume, replay, or restart the six-chapter tour
Optional quest · Draw your first line
Create a Shield or a Goal whenever you are ready. The badge is already yours.
See the day before changing it
The dashboard is yours. Next: draw your first boundary.

Usage history: tap a day to inspect it.
Top apps: the three biggest consumers today.
Your avatar is the door to level and achievements.
History becomes trustworthy after about three days.
This ring is today\'s screen time against your target. The flame is your current streak. You can tap the target anytime to change it.
Zenith gets sharper as it learns your patterns. Give it about three days before trusting the trend line.
A Shield blocks. A Goal rewards. Both appear in this list; tap one to open its app detail.
Bedtime, Alarm, Stats, and Pomodoro are one tap away. Use the Tune menu to choose which shortcuts you see.
Protection is a boundary, not a punishment
Draw your first line and the rest gets easier.

Delay App: a pause before a protected app opens.
Strict mode removes the easy exit.
Emergency uses are the planned escape hatch.
Auto-quit closes an app at the limit.
Bypass Restrictions skip schedules but are still tracked.
Focus holds Shields, Goals, and Schedules. Apps and Websites are separate surfaces, and each list only shows what you created.
This button adds any of the three tools. Long-press a card to select several at once.
A Shield stands between you and an app. Set a daily limit, add a delay, or make it strict. You can always spend an emergency use.
Goals don\'t block. They reward you for staying under a target, and they feed your XP.
A Schedule automates BLOCK or ALLOW windows by day and time. BLOCK schedules can intercept notifications.

QR and NFC tasks need a code or tag registered first.
Session HUD floats your remaining time.
Usage Glimpse shows a brief total every five minutes.
Audio Focus Intercept pauses media during an overlay.
Mindful Gateway interrupts every app that isn\'t whitelisted, even if it has no Shield. Defaults control uses, emergency, and pause behavior.
Pause Point asks for a small task before you continue. Waiting, breathing, walk, scan, slide, math, counting, typing, and more.
Reels Shield shares one daily limit across your chosen apps and presses back when it runs out. It needs accessibility.
Early Kick ejects you five minutes before a limit, so the stop is a warning instead of a surprise.
Eye Care runs the 20-20-20 rule with rest overlays you can\'t skip. Work and rest lengths are yours to set.

Bedtime history and wind-down live on the Bedtime screen.
Pomodoro keeps presets and session stats.
Grace Period can wrap past midnight with a weekly edit lock.
Tamper Protection adds an uninstall step and a PIN.
Bedtime blocks distracting apps, can wind you down, and can silence notifications. Add trusted apps to the allowlist.
Pomodoro alternates focus and rest, and can protect you from apps during a session. Save a preset for the way you actually work.
Grace Period lifts every restriction for a window you choose, up to two hours a day. Weekly Edit Lock keeps it from becoming permanent.
Lockdown blocks editing Shields, Goals, and Schedules during chosen hours. Turning it off takes a deliberate confirmation.
Alarms support text-to-speech, dismiss missions, gradual volume, and launching a wake-up app.
The numbers are yours to read.

Notification Insights recap your day and week.
Intercepted notifications feed an achievement.
Weekly and monthly summaries keep unlimited history.
App Detail can edit, pause, or delete its Shield or Goal.
This donut splits your day into Shield, Goal, and Other. Peak hours and the time profile sit right below.
The heatmap is your history at a glance. Swipe back through weeks, months, and years, and compare with last week.
Tap any app for App Detail: 21-day and hourly charts, battery, peak hour, and the Shield or Goal attached to it.
Website auto-tracking records time on domains across supported browsers, and website Shields work like app Shields.
Identity and resilience make it last
Make it yours, then keep it.

Widgets put streak and focus progress on your home screen.
Privacy hides apps and notification content.
Smart Repair and diagnostic export live in Data Management.
Tamper Protection and Lockdown guard your future self.
Avatar, banner, name, and bio are local to your device. The share card renders from them.
XP comes from Shield headroom and Goal targets. Levels unlock titles and avatar borders.
Explorer badges reward trying features. Accumulation badges grow over time. Your Path badge lives here too.
Theme, Dynamic Color, Expressive Colors, fonts, the floating tab bar, and Overlay Appearance all live here.
Auto and manual backup, restore, Smart Repair, privacy, and performance profiles. Set a backup and forget it.
